lines.text: Drop a metal spoon in a cup of water—it sinks straight down like an anchor!
Drop a solid cube of hard ice in—and it floats right to the surface!
Almost everything in the universe gets heavier and denser when it freezes!
Liquid wax sinks in liquid wax. Solid iron sinks in molten iron!
So why is water the magical exception on our planet?
When water freezes, molecules lock arms into an open, six-sided honeycomb crystal!
This trapped empty space makes ice about nine percent lighter than liquid water!
Because ice floats, frozen lake tops act as warm blankets so fish survive winter!
Discover nature's magical laws—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
